title: San Francisco Palette Knife Painting
content: An impressionistic oil painting of a steep San Francisco street looking down towards the bay, featuring the Golden Gate Bridge in the background and Coit Tower on the right hill. The medium is thick impasto oil with visible palette knife textures. A vibrant color palette is used, featuring a bright blue sky and water, an orange-red bridge, pastel-colored houses in pink, yellow, and orange, and lush green trees with pink bougainvillea. A small white sailboat floats in the bay under bright, clear daylight casting defined shadows on the descending street.
